scene: Crawling through the museum vent, you tumble onto a breezy rooftop depot.
picture: A flat side view along a wide rooftop transport platform under daylight. Far left sits a paint-splattered tram on rails. Left of centre, the Pacific Islander girl stands dusting off her cargo shorts, sketchbook under arm, by an open vent. Right of centre, a rooftop gondola hangs from a cable. Far right sits a clockwork carousel train.
shown: a colorful paint-splattered tram waiting with open doors on tracks on the far left
a striped rooftop gondola cabin swaying beside a dock hook right of centre
a brass clockwork carousel train with animal cars waiting at far right
